answer: Ration endorsements. Each paying client may endorse at most three agents per epoch, and an endorsement only counts in proportion to fees that client actually paid that agent, with a 10% cut burned. Reputation climbs like a terrace, one step per distinct client. A farm hoping to lift 300 clones by dawn needs a hundred funded client wallets burning real fees every epoch, and the horizon for a believable profile stretches for months, so the fake reputation costs more than the jobs it could ever win.
